flags.message: record/documents/ holds only the petition and QP text (fetched 2026-07-17). The docket now carries a supplemental brief (2026-06-16) and a brief in opposition (2026-09-14) that were not provisioned; I retrieved both from supremecourt.gov. The BIO materially changes the read (it shows the Third Circuit's ground is independent of Jules), so other predictors in this fan-out working from the baseline alone are on a different information set.

context.json has band 'baseline' and response_requested null, but the snapshot shows 'Response Requested' on 2026-07-15 after the respondent waived. The sal-v4 band does not register a call for a response, so the scored anchor (~5%) sits well below the state this docket shows; consider whether the CFR should feed the band or a statpack cut.

Decisive public signal predating the snapshot: the lead case petitioners ask to be held for, Jules v. Andre Balazs Properties (No. 25-83), was decided 2026-05-14. I used its holding as forward context; it is not this petition's outcome.
